title: Regression tests model an unreachable 'clean stamp + lost slot write' window — the verdict stamp derives from the same slot whose write is claimed lost
evidence:
test_gate_state_marshalling.py:468-471: "attempt 1 models the state-prop failure — the clean ``output_key`` write is LOST (the review slot is left untouched) while the clean verdict stamp LANDS (written from the judge's OWN ctx, immune to the pipeline node's state-view bug). This is exactly the window the per-attempt slot-clear protects against." compliance_enforcement.py:371-375: "review = _read_review(callback_context)
    if review is None:
        _emit_failed_review_rollup(callback_context)
        return None
    _emit_review_telemetry(callback_context, review.value, review.review_key)" compliance_enforcement.py:280-287: "# Stamp the fail-closed verdict ...
    _stamp_review_verdict(
        callback_context,
        review_key,
        passed=False,
        parseable=False,
        violation_count=0,
    )"
detail: A clean stamp requires _read_review to see a parseable review — same slot. Lost write → passed=False rollup stamp → finalize fail-closes like pre-fix. Pop is correct hygiene, but cannot rescue a clean verdict.
recommended_fix: Re-scope title/comments to the real guarantee: stale non-None reviews can never reach finalize; slot authoritative per-attempt. Optionally model the reachable window (dirty rollup stamp) and assert the honest fail-close path.

title: Briefing suite claim '11 integration' does not reproduce — full integration run is 34 passed + 15 xfailed
evidence: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/integration -q` -> '34 passed, 15 xfailed, 16 warnings in 0.38s'. 11 = count of integration files WITHOUT @pytest.mark.xfail('Requires model access') markers, not a passing-test count (those 11 files contain 34 tests).
detail: Green either way; '11' matches only the count of files lacking model-access xfail markers, not tests (34 pass). Unit claim 2051 exact.
recommended_fix: Correct future briefings to '34 passed + 15 xfailed (model-access)' — or state 11 as the LLM-free file count explicitly.
